n = int(input())

second_chars = prefix_candidates[1]

possible_strings = []

possible_string = first_chars + second_chars[-1]
possible_strings.append(possible_string)

            prefixes.add(possible_string[:i + 1])
            suffixes.add(possible_string[i + 1:])
    all_prefixes = set()
    all_suffixes = set()

            all_prefixes.add(s)
            all_suffixes.add(s[::-1])

    if s in possible_string[:n - 1]:
        output.append('P')
